description: This file defines the 'Format' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically handling text data formatting functions such as DOLLAR, FIXED, TEXT, VALUE, and NUMBERVALUE. It includes methods for formatting values with currency, fixed decimal, custom formats, and conversions between text and numeric date/time formats.

classes.name: Format
classes.description: Provides static methods for various text data formatting operations within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including currency formatting, fixed decimal formatting, text formatting, value conversion, and number value parsing.

methods.name: DOLLAR
methods.description: Converts a number to formatted currency text, with rounding and decimal places specified.

methods.name: FIXEDFORMAT
methods.description: Formats a number with a fixed number of decimal places, optionally removing thousand separators.

methods.name: TEXTFORMAT
methods.description: Formats a value into a text string based on the specified format mask, with special handling for date/time.

methods.name: convertValue
methods.description: Private helper to convert input to a numeric or boolean value, considering string trimming and boolean compatibility.

methods.name: VALUE
methods.description: Interprets a value as a float, integer, date, or time, and handles string conversions appropriately.

methods.name: valueToText
methods.description: Converts a value to its text representation, considering formatting options.

methods.name: getDecimalSeparator
methods.description: Helper for retrieving the decimal separator, defaulting to locale settings.

methods.name: getGroupSeparator
methods.description: Helper for retrieving the thousands/group separator, defaulting to locale settings.

methods.name: NUMBERVALUE
methods.description: Converts a formatted number string into a float, considering specified decimal and thousand separators.
